description: The preceding optional and its terminator lie inside another plain optional with a ranked group. The group contains no capture. The present route reads D and then the written T, so .tags(r) returns the empty set (engine §4).
grammar:
%rule text $r:input :: $r.tags(r)
%rule input B D T Z
%rule r :: Queried | B [[(c ≻ c)] [+T] D T] Z
%rule c D
